notes: Both parts proved in Lean (Mathlib): det_circulant_zmod (circulant determinant over ZMod n as the product of DFT eigenvalues, built from ZMod.stdAddChar), A228884_eq_prod (a(n) = prod_{k<n} lambda(n,k), lambda(n,k) = sum_{d|n, (n/d)|k} phi(d) n/d), A228884_pos and A228884_dvd (part (i)), A228884_ii (part (ii): lambda(n,k) = L(n, gcd(k,n)), L multiplicative, local factors (b+1)p^{a-1}(p-1) and p^{a-1}(a(p-1)+p) have prime factors < n for composite n). Outside Lean: none.
